declaring_sources.adapter_surfaces: adapters/codex (X01) and adapters/claude-code (X02) committed surfaces are evaluated as they stand; parity is measured over the sealed adapter role maps, never over live provider calls
declaring_sources.parity_surface: manifests/role_registry.yaml (the canonical role set is read from the registry, never restated in the eval)

canonical_outputs_comparable.mechanism: both the Codex and Claude Code adapters are measured against the canonical role registry: the role set aligns, each role carries the registry output-schema reference on both adapters, the host agent type and Claude surface are uniform, and write-capable roles stay isolation-tracked; a dropped role, a rebound output schema, an unnamed host descriptor, or isolation that stops tracking a write scope is each refused with its own typed finding

vendor_diversity_not_assumed_independent.mechanism: provider diversity is reported as a number, not an assumption: the 2x2 error contingency and phi coefficient are recomputed from the raw synthetic trials, the observed joint-error rate is shown to exceed the rate independence would predict, and a fixture asserting independence or a provider presented as live is each refused; the committed results artifact is re-derived from the sealed surfaces and any drift breaks its own hash

independent_review.evidence: review.md (author: bounded X04 implementation agent; reviewer: the sealing session, which did not author this attempt; actor_independence between author and reviewer holds, external certification does not)
